dedupe_keys.name: ukraine state property fund unified register of state property objects data gov ua

description: State Property Fund of Ukraine (Фонд державного майна України) publishes the register of state-sector business entities (state enterprises, their associations, subsidiaries and companies with a state share above 50 percent) with data on their managing bodies and some financial and economic indicators, together with information on state immovable property (buildings and structures); the portal record has 74 CSV resources. Coverage: Ukraine nationally; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-22. Format and access: CSV files, free and without registration from data.gov.ua; the portal catalogue is queryable through a public CKAN API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution (as shown by the portal record); cost: free. Caveats: the register is about the state-owned enterprise and property side, not a map of buildings; the description on the portal record is partly cut, the 74 files were not opened, and the property fields and coverage are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: identifying the ownership and managing bodies of state-owned buildings and facilities for asset-portfolio, resilience-funding and post-conflict reconstruction planning. Related catalogue records: Ukraine connectivity of schools, hospitals and libraries: locations, fibre and internet connection, providers and school speed tests (Ministry of Digital Transformation, 2020 to 2021) (data-mintsyfra-ukraine-social-institutions-fibre-connectivity); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
